messages:
platform-ops: Heads-up — we have a planned, staggered node restart for serving-cluster-eu beginning tonight at 00:30 UTC. This is a rolling restart (no overlap) to pick up a kernel security patch and a small runtime fix. Estimated window: 00:30–01:30 UTC. Expected user impact: transient 30–90s connection failures for requests routed to a node while it drains; overall availability should remain within SLA due to rolling pattern. :shield:

platform-ops: Plan outline: canary (5% traffic) -> pause 10m -> 25% -> pause 10m -> remaining nodes. If any regression, rollback path is to stop the restart and reattach drained nodes, then roll back kernel package (playbook linked). We will run prefix cache warmup after each group.

platform-ops: Operational actions I need from folks:
- @oncall-marc to lead the on-call runbook and be primary for pager after 00:15 UTC
- @elaine.k to bless the customer-facing notice and post to status.redwood.ai when we move to canary
- @support-liz to queue outbound emails for customers subscribed to maintenance notices
- @product-priya if there's any blocking customer we should carve out

oncall-marc: Ack — I’ll be on for the window. I’ll run canary at 00:30 and hold for 10m. If we see >1% error spike above baseline or tail latency jumps >250ms P95, we abort. I’ve added the quick rollback steps to my local runbook.

elaine.k: Draft status page copy (FYI):
```
We are performing a rolling restart of a subset of inference nodes in eu-west to apply a security patch. Users may see short-lived errors (up to ~90s) for requests served by individual nodes while they are drained and restarted. We expect no prolonged outages. Next updates will be posted at the start of the canary and on completion.
```
Please confirm and I’ll post when you say go.

mike_r: +1 on the canary. Ops note: use this drain command with graceful timeout so active KV cache writes finish:
```bash
kubectl drain node/<node-name> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
# then cordon -> restart -> uncordon
```
Also we’ll run a small postfix of 5k warmup queries to rebuild caches after each group.

support-liz: I’ve prepped two customer templates: short and detailed. Short subject: "Planned maintenance — rolling node restarts (eu-west)". Detailed body includes expected times, possible transient errors, and contact route (support@redwood.ai). I’ll hold send until status page update is live for canary.

product-priya: No flagged customers on the blocklist for this window. Please ping me if a high-traffic enterprise sees repeated regressions and we need to schedule a dedicated maintenance window.

deploy-bot: preflight-check: kernel-patch-bundle sha1=ab12f3 OK; rollout-script lint OK; required nodes reachable: 98/100.

incident-bot: scheduled_maintenance created: id=sm-2026-2165004321; reminder at 00:15 UTC. Page subscribers: infra-team, support, eng-oncall.

platform-ops: Posting status page now for canary start at 00:30. Will annotate with canary timestamp and escalate to customers if we hit abort criteria.

elaine.k: Posted status page entry and set component state to "Under Maintenance" for eu-west-serving. Copy: (same as draft) + link to support ticket form.

oncall-marc: Canary started at 00:30 UTC — monitoring tail latencies and error rates. So far baseline looks normal (errors within noise). Holding for 10m.

mike_r: Canary warmup complete, KV cache warm for canary nodes. No backend trace anomalies yet.

oncall-marc: Moving to 25% at 00:42 UTC.

platform-ops: Noted. I’ll update status page to reflect progress -> "In progress: 25% complete".

support-liz: Triggered customer notice (short) to maintenance subscribers. Included the status page link and contact route.

platform-ops: Completed rolling restart at 01:18 UTC. Final check: all nodes back and uncordoned, health checks passing, no elevated error budget burn. Post-maintenance actions: run full synthetic suite for 30m, and keep extra tracing retention for 24h.

platform-ops: Final status update posted: "Maintenance completed — services healthy. If you see any issues, open a ticket or ping #support." Thanks everyone for the quick coordination. :tada:

elaine.k: I’ll send the completion email to customers in 10m with summary and links to the incident log.

oncall-marc: Taking post-maintenance watch for 2h, reachable via oncall page.

support-liz: Closing the notify loop on our side — inboxes monitored.

platform-ops: Archiving this thread and attaching the runbook diff + postmortem template for any follow-up.
